# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Text — 1 token; Fills and status backgrounds — 1 token; Palette ramps and brand — 5 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 8 tokens; Radius — 3 tokens.

## Color · Text

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--ink, #2b1b1a);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone */
color: #2b1b1a;
```

### Tokens (1)

| token | light | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--ink` | #2b1b1a | Body copy and UI text on cream and blush (14.5:1 on cream, 11.2:1 on blush). |

## Color · Fills and status backgrounds

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--on-sakura-red, #f5f0ea);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone */
color: #f5f0ea;
```

### Tokens (1)

| token | light | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--on-sakura-red` | #f5f0ea | Text and icons on a sakura-red fill, such as primary buttons and the reversed logo (10.1:1). |

## Color · Palette ramps and brand

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--sakura-red, #741211);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone */
color: #741211;
```

### Tokens (5)

| token | light | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--sakura-red` | #741211 | Brand colour: the logo mark and wordmark, headings, links and primary buttons. Text on cream (10.1:1) and blush (7.8:1). |
| `--cream` | #f5f0ea | Page ground and the light fill of cards. Text on it: ink, sakura-red, warm-charcoal, rose. |
| `--warm-charcoal` | #5c5250 | Secondary text and captions on cream (6.7:1) and blush (5.2:1). |
| `--blush` | #ebcfcb | Soft panels, input backgrounds and quiet highlights. Carries ink, warm-charcoal, sakura-red or rose text. |
| `--rose` | #9e3c44 | Small accent: highlights, icons, decorative marks, sale or notice text. Text on cream (5.8:1) and blush (4.5:1). |

## Type

Set text in one of the styles below: write its values from the Styles and Families tables, or, on a page that links or inlines tokens.css, prefer its variable, where the Styles table’s CSS column gives one.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a style’s values from the Styles and Families tables */
font: 400 64px/68px "Crimson Text", Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif; letter-spacing: 0.12em;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the variables, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
font: var(--text-display-xl); letter-spacing: 0.12em;
font-family: var(--font-display);   /* the family alone */
```

### Styles

| style | CSS | size / line, italic, letter spacing | weight | family | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `display-xl` | `.display-xl`, `--text-display-xl` | 64px / 68px, letter-spacing 0.12em | 400 | `display` | Hero wordmark-style headline, one per page. sakura-red on cream. |
| `headline` | `.headline`, `--text-headline` | 40px / 48px, letter-spacing 0.04em | 400 | `display` | Page and section headlines, sentence case. |
| `title` | `.title`, `--text-title` | 24px / 32px, letter-spacing 0.02em | 400 | `display` | Card titles and sub-headings. |
| `body` | `.body`, `--text-body` | 16px / 26px | 400 | `sans` | Running text in ink. |
| `body-sm` | `.body-sm`, `--text-body-sm` | 14px / 22px | 400 | `sans` | Captions, form notes and legal text in warm-charcoal. |
| `label` | `.label`, `--text-label` | 12px / 16px, letter-spacing 0.32em | 500 | `sans` | Eyebrows, buttons and tags, set in capitals; echoes the NAILS line of the logo. |

### Families

| family | CSS variable | stack |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `display` | `--font-display` | `"Crimson Text", Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif` |
| `sans` | `--font-sans` | `"Montserrat", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif` |

## Spacing

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below */
padding: 4px;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the token’s name, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
padding: var(--space-1);
```

### Tokens (8)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--space-1` | 4px | Icon-to-label gaps. |
| `--space-2` | 8px | Tight gaps between related items. |
| `--space-3` | 12px | Gap between a label and its field. |
| `--space-4` | 16px | Default padding inside inputs and buttons. |
| `--space-6` | 24px | Card padding and gaps between stacked items. |
| `--space-8` | 32px | Gaps between groups of content. |
| `--space-12` | 48px | Section padding and the petal-pattern pitch. |
| `--space-16` | 64px | Gaps between page sections. |

## Radius

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below (--radius-sm: 4px) */
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer var(--radius-sm), so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
```

### Tokens (3)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--radius-sm` | 4px | Inputs and small tags. |
| `--radius-md` | 12px | Cards, panels and colour blocks. |
| `--radius-pill` | 999px | Buttons; half the short side of the control. |
